zh-Hans.translation: 需要指挥官个人资料来更改任务进度。

zh-Hans.source: A commander profile must be loaded first.
zh-Hans.translation: 必须首先加载指挥官配置文件。

zh-Hans.source: A compatible live construction depot is ready.
zh-Hans.translation: 兼容的实时施工站已准备就绪。

zh-Hans.source: A correct site type and heading make the projected map line up with the ruins or structure.
zh-Hans.translation: 正确的场地类型和标题可使投影地图与废墟或结构对齐。

zh-Hans.source: A current journal system is required, or search for a prior system.
zh-Hans.translation: 需要当前的日志系统，或者搜索以前的系统。

zh-Hans.source: A current ship and surface position are required to calibrate its cockpit offset.
zh-Hans.translation: 需要当前的船舶和表面位置来校准其驾驶舱偏移。

zh-Hans.source: A cyan obelisk with a 90-degree radial glow is active. The glow center is cyan when its log is needed for the active Ram Tah mission, orange when scanned, and light gray when active but neither needed nor scanned.
zh-Hans.translation: 带有 90 度径向发光的青色方尖碑处于活动状态。当活跃的 Ram Tah 任务需要其日志时，发光中心呈青色；当被扫描时，发光中心呈橙色；当活跃但既不需要也不被扫描时，发光中心呈浅灰色。

zh-Hans.source: A dashed dark-red line through site center is the recorded site alignment heading and rotates with the live Commander view.
zh-Hans.translation: 穿过站点中心的深红色虚线是记录的站点对齐方向，并随实时 Commander 视图旋转。

zh-Hans.source: A default Codex image cache directory is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 需要默认的 Codex 图像缓存目录。

zh-Hans.source: A dimmed PIP means that organism has already been analyzed for the current body. Its reward band remains visible for reference, but it is no longer an outstanding sample.
zh-Hans.translation: 变暗的 PIP 意味着已经对当前身体的有机体进行了分析。它的奖励带仍然可见以供参考，但它不再是一个出色的样本。

zh-Hans.source: A dot and radius mark one of the eight reusable tracked surface locations. Inactive bookmarks are dimmed.
zh-Hans.translation: 点和半径标记八个可重复使用的跟踪表面位置之一。不活动的书签呈灰色。

zh-Hans.source: A dotted ring marks a point or site state that still needs survey data.
zh-Hans.translation: 虚线环标记仍需要测量数据的点或站点状态。

zh-Hans.source: A filled discovery flag is a Commander first; an outline flag is a regional first. Highlighting regional firsts is optional.
zh-Hans.translation: 填充的发现标志首先是指挥官；大纲标志是地区首创。突出地区第一是可选的。

zh-Hans.source: A filled flag marks a Commander first, an outline flag marks a Commander regional first, and a sun marks a potential Galactic-region first from external candidate data.
zh-Hans.translation: 实心旗帜首先标记指挥官，轮廓旗帜首先标记指挥官区域，而太阳则首先根据外部候选数据标记潜在的银河区域。

zh-Hans.source: A first-discovery flag means the body was not previously discovered according to the journal data.
zh-Hans.translation: 首次发现标志意味着根据日志数据，该尸体之前并未被发现。

zh-Hans.source: A gold target circle means the Commander is outside the objective radius; the accent color means the Commander is inside it.
zh-Hans.translation: 金色目标圆圈表示指挥官位于目标半径之外；强调色表示指挥官在其中。

zh-Hans.source: A gold-filled, yellow-edged circle identifies a surveyed artifact puddle with no object present.
zh-Hans.translation: 一个充满金色、黄边的圆圈标识了一个被调查的人工制品水坑，其中不存在任何物体。

zh-Hans.source: A ground target stores latitude and longitude for the current body and turns them into bearing, distance, and approach guidance.
zh-Hans.translation: 地面目标存储当前物体的纬度和经度，并将它们转化为方位、距离和进场指导。

zh-Hans.source: A hatched reward PIP is a prediction. A solid PIP is a confirmed organism. A trailing question mark means that organism is still predicted rather than identified; hover it for the exact state.
zh-Hans.translation: 孵化的奖励 PIP 是一种预测。固体 PIP 是已确认的生物体。后面的问号意味着生物体仍然是预测的而不是识别的；将其悬停以获取确切的状态。

zh-Hans.source: A journal folder is required to replay quest events.
zh-Hans.translation: 重播任务事件需要日志文件夹。

zh-Hans.source: A known battery or energy-cell location in a human settlement.
zh-Hans.translation: 人类住区中已知的电池或能量电池位置。

zh-Hans.source: A known medical-kit location in a human settlement.
zh-Hans.translation: 人类住区中已知的医疗箱位置。

zh-Hans.source: A labeled circle marks a frontline checkpoint. The local checkpoint uses the configured local/success color.
zh-Hans.translation: 一个带标签的圆圈标志着前线检查站。本地检查点使用配置的本地/成功颜色。

zh-Hans.source: A large circle labeled SHIP marks the current or departed ship. A dashed boundary can show the dismissal distance.
zh-Hans.translation: 标有“船舶”的大圆圈标记当前或离开的船舶。虚线边界可以显示解除距离。

zh-Hans.source: A live commander measurement at the selected active site is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 需要在选定的活动地点进行实时指挥测量。

zh-Hans.source: A live construction depot is required before a project can be created.
zh-Hans.translation: 创建项目之前需要有一个实时施工站。

zh-Hans.source: A muted dot is a prior scan location. A danger-colored radius means the Commander is currently too close to reuse that colony area.
zh-Hans.translation: 静音点是先前的扫描位置。危险颜色的半径意味着指挥官目前距离该殖民地区域太近，无法再使用该区域。

zh-Hans.source: A named atmospheric-control point in a human settlement.
zh-Hans.translation: 人类住区中的一个指定的大气控制点。

zh-Hans.source: A named power-control point in a human settlement.
zh-Hans.translation: 人类住区中的一个指定的电力控制点。

zh-Hans.source: A new route could not be started: {0}
A no-carrier response is cached normally and does not trigger repeated refreshes.
zh-Hans.translation: 无运营商响应会正常缓存，不会触发重复刷新。

zh-Hans.source: A parent contains eight child cubes at the next lower mass code. This nested layout explains why systems with different prefixes can be close together and systems sharing a large high-mass boxel can be far apart.
zh-Hans.translation: 父立方体包含八个位于下一个较低质量代码的子立方体。这种嵌套布局解释了为什么具有不同前缀的系统可以靠近在一起，而共享大质量盒子的系统可以相距很远。

zh-Hans.source: A passive overlay is click-through. The live-interaction shortcut temporarily makes existing live overlays draggable without opening the full position editor.
zh-Hans.translation: 被动覆盖是点击。实时交互快捷方式暂时使现有的实时叠加可拖动，而无需打开完整位置编辑器。

zh-Hans.source: A positive Codex entry ID is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 需要一个正的法典条目 ID。

zh-Hans.source: A quest objective exists but the Commander is not yet within its required target area.
zh-Hans.translation: 任务目标已存在，但指挥官尚未位于其所需的目标区域内。

zh-Hans.source: A question mark inside the unknown-color frame means there is not enough dependable organism or reward data to calculate a band yet.
zh-Hans.translation: 未知颜色框内的问号意味着还没有足够的可靠有机体或奖励数据来计算带。

zh-Hans.source: A reward range appears when unresolved signals could match organisms with different values.
zh-Hans.translation: 当未解决的信号可以匹配具有不同值的生物体时，就会出现奖励范围。

zh-Hans.source: A ring with a center dot marks the Commander's live position on the Guardian site projection.
zh-Hans.translation: 带有中心点的圆环标记了指挥官在守护者站点投影上的实时位置。

zh-Hans.source: A rotated rectangular outline and pad number show a settlement landing pad and its orientation.
zh-Hans.translation: 旋转的矩形轮廓和垫编号显示了沉降着陆垫及其方向。

zh-Hans.source: A rounded rectangle marks the Surface Recon Vehicle.
zh-Hans.translation: 圆角矩形标志着地面侦察车。

zh-Hans.source: A rounded square labeled SRV marks the vehicle on the settlement map.
zh-Hans.translation: 标记为 SRV 的圆角正方形在定居点地图上标记了车辆。

zh-Hans.source: A rounded square with a center line marks a data terminal. A dim/processed color means it has already been handled.
zh-Hans.translation: 带有中心线的圆角正方形标志着数据终端。暗淡/经过处理的颜色意味着它已经被处理过。

zh-Hans.source: A saved overlay theme name must contain 1 to 80 characters.
zh-Hans.translation: 保存的叠加主题名称必须包含 1 到 80 个字符。

zh-Hans.source: A scanned body and live surface coordinates are required to toggle a quick tracker.
zh-Hans.translation: 需要扫描的身体和实时表面坐标来切换快速跟踪器。

zh-Hans.source: A short filled bar marks a secure door. Green, cyan, gold, and danger colors correspond to increasing security levels.
zh-Hans.translation: 一个短实心条标志着一扇安全门。绿色、青色、金色和危险颜色对应于不断提高的安全级别。

zh-Hans.source: A small outlined dot marks material already collected at that settlement position.
zh-Hans.translation: 一个小轮廓点标记了已经在该定居点收集的材料。

zh-Hans.source: A spherical search finds candidate systems inside a radius around a central coordinate.
zh-Hans.translation: 球形搜索查找中心坐标周围半径内的候选系统。

zh-Hans.source: A standalone question mark means the signal, organism, site detail, or reward cannot yet be identified reliably from current data.
zh-Hans.translation: 独立的问号意味着信号、有机体、位点细节或奖励尚无法从当前数据中可靠地识别。

zh-Hans.source: A successful import restarts SrvSurvey automatically so no pre-import in-memory state can overwrite migrated data.
zh-Hans.translation: 成功导入会自动重新启动 SrvSurvey，因此导入前的内存状态不会覆盖已迁移的数据。

zh-Hans.source: A target-radius circle marks quest geometry. Gold means outside the target; the active accent means within it.
zh-Hans.translation: 目标半径圆标记任务几何形状。金色表示超出目标；主动重音表示在其中。

zh-Hans.source: A trailing question mark means the body criteria predict the colored species, but a DSS or organic scan has not confirmed it. Hover the marker in the overlay for its state description.
zh-Hans.translation: 后面的问号意味着身体标准预测了有色物种，但 DSS 或有机扫描尚未证实这一点。将标记悬停在叠加层中以获取其状态描述。

zh-Hans.source: A translucent blue line through site center is the general relic-tower heading. A wider, fainter line through one relic records that tower's individual heading.
zh-Hans.translation: 穿过遗址中心的半透明蓝线是一般遗迹塔的方向。穿过一个遗迹的一条更宽、更暗的线记录了该塔的单独走向。

zh-Hans.source: A triangle marks the current ship. A dim triangle marks a former ship position.
zh-Hans.translation: 三角形标记当前船舶。一个暗淡的三角形标志着以前的船位置。

zh-Hans.source: A visual reference for route and body artwork, text symbols, biology reward PIPs, surface-radar markers, Guardian points, and human-settlement map icons.
zh-Hans.translation: 路线和人体艺术作品、文本符号、生物奖励 PIP、表面雷达标记、监护点和人类住区地图图标的视觉参考。
转换屏幕截图的绝对目的地
包含 Elite 屏幕截图的绝对文件夹

zh-Hans.source: Acquire the required Raven system-update permission and API key.
zh-Hans.translation: 获取所需的 Raven 系统更新权限和 API 密钥。

zh-Hans.source: Activate a boxel search before auditing its full area.
zh-Hans.translation: 在审核其整个区域之前激活方框搜索。

zh-Hans.source: Activate a boxel search before refreshing systems.
zh-Hans.translation: 在刷新系统之前激活 boxel 搜索。

zh-Hans.source: Activate a boxel search to audit its full area.
zh-Hans.translation: 激活方框搜索以审核其整个区域。

zh-Hans.source: Activate a saved route before changing next-hop auto-copy.
zh-Hans.translation: 在更改下一跳自动复制之前激活已保存的路由。

zh-Hans.source: Activated {0} verified reference update(s). Restart SrvSurvey to use them.
zh-Hans.translation: 已激活 {0} 已验证的参考更新。重新启动 SrvSurvey 即可使用它们。

zh-Hans.source: Active quest geometry can add routes and target radii to a human-settlement map, while massacre missions track credited kills by mission giver.
zh-Hans.translation: 主动任务几何体可以将路线和目标半径添加到人类住区地图中，而屠杀任务则跟踪任务给予者的杀戮记录。

zh-Hans.source: Add a tracker from Composition Scanner discoveries
zh-Hans.translation: 添加来自合成扫描仪发现的跟踪器

zh-Hans.source: Add anything useful about this system...
zh-Hans.translation: 添加任何有关该系统有用的内容...
添加有关此访问的注释...

zh-Hans.source: Add planning notes, reminders, or a description for this route.
zh-Hans.translation: 添加此路线的计划注释、提醒或说明。

zh-Hans.source: Add system, body, commander, and location banner
zh-Hans.translation: 添加系统、身体、指挥官和位置横幅

zh-Hans.source: Add the steps or game activity that led to this error.
zh-Hans.translation: 添加导致此错误的步骤或游戏活动。

zh-Hans.source: Added a data terminal to the local draft.
zh-Hans.translation: 在本地草案中添加了数据终端。

zh-Hans.source: Added a local raw {0} point to the Guardian survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 在卫报调查中添加了本地原始 {0} 点。

zh-Hans.source: Added a secure door with the current relative heading.
zh-Hans.translation: 添加了具有当前相对航向的安全门。

zh-Hans.source: Added a {0} m circle to the pending building.
zh-Hans.translation: 向待处理建筑物添加了 {0} m 圆圈。

zh-Hans.source: Added building '{0}' to the local draft.
zh-Hans.translation: 将建筑物“{0}”添加到本地草稿中。
添加了测量的主模板点 {0}。

zh-Hans.source: Added path {0} to the pending building.
zh-Hans.translation: 已将路径 {0} 添加到待处理的建筑物。

zh-Hans.source: Added {0} as a local raw {1} point. Save the survey to persist it.
zh-Hans.translation: 添加了 {0} 作为本地原始 {1} 点。保存调查以保留它。

zh-Hans.source: Adding embedded banner to future screenshots
zh-Hans.translation: 将嵌入的横幅添加到未来的屏幕截图中

zh-Hans.source: Adjustment mode is active. Save creates a verified plotters.json backup.
zh-Hans.translation: 调整模式已激活。保存创建经过验证的 plotters.json 备份。

zh-Hans.source: Advanced tools can measure new layouts, edit points and groups, and package a survey for review.
zh-Hans.translation: 高级工具可以测量新布局、编辑点和组，以及打包调查以供审核。

zh-Hans.source: After creation, SrvSurvey reads the sites again. If the new project displaced the original first site, it sends an order-only correction with the original site first.
zh-Hans.translation: 创建后，SrvSurvey 再次读取站点。如果新项目取代了原来的第一个站点，它会首先向原始站点发送仅订单更正。

zh-Hans.source: All publication remains off unless you explicitly enable it. Imported profiles retain the original choices.
zh-Hans.translation: 除非您明确启用，否则所有发布都会保持关闭状态。导入的配置文件保留原始选择。

zh-Hans.source: All signals analyzed with the first-footfall bonus applied.
zh-Hans.translation: 所有信号均采用首次客流量奖励进行分析。

zh-Hans.source: All uploads use the live EDDN gateway. Enable test schemas only for uploader testing or non-live game data; test-schema messages are not consumed as production data. No EDDN account, API key, or token is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 所有上传均使用实时 EDDN 网关。仅针对上传者测试或非实时游戏数据启用测试模式；测试模式消息不会作为生产数据使用。不需要 EDDN 帐户、API 密钥或令牌。

zh-Hans.source: Also displays the overlay in supercruise when the navigation destination matches the next followed-route system.
zh-Hans.translation: 当导航目的地与下一个跟随路线系统匹配时，还会在超级巡航中显示叠加层。

zh-Hans.source: Also show in the navigation panel
Also show in the system map
Alt+B toggles details for the current or selected body. The panel stays hidden inside the configured Sol radius unless that rule is disabled.
zh-Hans.translation: Alt+B 切换当前或选定主体的详细信息。除非禁用该规则，否则面板将隐藏在配置的太阳半径内。

zh-Hans.source: Alt+Ctrl+I toggles data banners for future screenshots.
zh-Hans.translation: Alt+Ctrl+I 切换数据横幅以供将来的屏幕截图使用。

zh-Hans.source: Alt+Ctrl+O toggles this capture window. Its enabled state is restored at startup.
zh-Hans.translation: Alt+Ctrl+O 切换此捕获窗口。其启用状态在启动时恢复。

zh-Hans.source: Ambiguous or missing matches are not changed and remain retryable.
zh-Hans.translation: 不明确或缺失的匹配不会更改，并且仍然可以重试。

zh-Hans.source: Ambiguous shared Cargo.json data is suppressed while multiple Elite windows are detected. A fresh unambiguous cargo write is required before cargo can re-enter plans or publishing.
zh-Hans.translation: 当检测到多个 Elite 窗口时，不明确的共享 Cargo.json 数据将被抑制。在货物重新进入计划或发布之前，需要进行新的明确的货物写入。

zh-Hans.source: An Inara API key is saved for {0}.
zh-Hans.translation: 已为 {0} 保存 Inara API 密钥。

zh-Hans.source: An active commander Guardian survey is required for that command.
zh-Hans.translation: 该命令需要主动指挥官监护人调查。

zh-Hans.source: An active commander profile is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 需要有效的指挥官配置文件。

zh-Hans.source: An active obelisk receives an emphasized ring; a scanned obelisk is filled with the success color.
zh-Hans.translation: 活跃的方尖碑上有一个强调的圆环；扫描的方尖碑充满了成功的颜色。

zh-Hans.source: An alarm-control point in a human settlement. Its color reflects access/security context.
zh-Hans.translation: 人类住区中的警报控制点。它的颜色反映了访问/安全上下文。

zh-Hans.source: An aligned settlement and current surface position are required for this measurement.
zh-Hans.translation: 此测量需要对齐的沉降和当前表面位置。

zh-Hans.source: An authorization or security-clearance point in a human settlement.
zh-Hans.translation: 人类住区中的授权或安全许可点。

zh-Hans.source: An open chevron points toward a near or standard target. A double chevron marks a target beyond its defined far threshold; markers without one use 1 km.
zh-Hans.translation: 开放的 V 形图案指向近处或标准目标。双 V 形标记标记超出其定义的远阈值的目标； 1公里无标记一次使用。

zh-Hans.source: An orange star containing a fuel droplet marks a route waypoint where the ship should refuel by fuel scooping.
zh-Hans.translation: 含有燃料滴的橙色星星标记了一个航路点，船舶应在该航路点通过燃油舀取加油。

zh-Hans.source: An overlay colour name cannot be empty.
zh-Hans.translation: 叠加颜色名称不能为空。

zh-Hans.source: An overlay theme state is not a JSON object.
zh-Hans.translation: 覆盖主题状态不是 JSON 对象。

zh-Hans.source: An overlay timer requires a positive interval.
zh-Hans.translation: 覆盖计时器需要正间隔。

zh-Hans.source: An unhatched PIP means the organism and its reward are confirmed. Each filled segment clears one reward threshold; black empty slots show thresholds the reward does not reach. The dotted outer frame and solid segment outlines are independently themeable.
zh-Hans.translation: 未孵化的 PIP 意味着生物体及其奖励已得到确认。每个填充的分段都会清除一个奖励阈值；黑色空槽显示奖励未达到的阈值。虚线外框和实线段轮廓可独立主题化。

zh-Hans.source: Analysis, previews, imports, and historical reconstruction do not imply network publication.
zh-Hans.translation: 分析、预览、导入、历史重构并不意味着网络发布。

zh-Hans.source: Analyze journals to find historical Green Gas Giant candidates. Analysis never publishes them.
zh-Hans.translation: 分析期刊以寻找历史上的绿色气体巨头候选者。分析从未公布过它们。

zh-Hans.source: Analyze journals, review the candidate count, and confirm historical publication first.
zh-Hans.translation: 首先分析期刊、查看候选数量并确认历史发表情况。

zh-Hans.source: Another SrvSurvey instance is running. Confirm whether all instances should close before updating.
zh-Hans.translation: 另一个 SrvSurvey 实例正在运行。确认更新前是否应关闭所有实例。

zh-Hans.source: Appears below 100 m while on foot or in an SRV at a settlement whose faction is at war or civil war.
zh-Hans.translation: 在派系处于战争或内战的定居点步行或乘坐 SRV 时，出现在 100 m 以下。

zh-Hans.source: Appears in supercruise, the navigation panel, or the system map and marks the selected destination.
zh-Hans.translation: 出现在超级巡航、导航面板或系统地图中并标记所选目的地。
应用程序日志记录不可用。
应用程序日志和崩溃报告

zh-Hans.source: Application theme changes the main Avalonia windows and supports the Raven Colonial light and dark palettes.
zh-Hans.translation: 应用程序主题更改了 Avalonia 主窗口并支持 Raven Colonial 浅色和深色调色板。
应用程序主题与覆盖主题

zh-Hans.source: Application theme, in-game overlay appearance, and overlay configuration
zh-Hans.translation: 应用程序主题、游戏内叠加外观和叠加配置

zh-Hans.source: Application update checks verify checksum-indexed packages and can automatically roll back a failed startup.
zh-Hans.translation: 应用程序更新检查验证校验和索引的包，并可以自动回滚失败的启动。

zh-Hans.source: Applied overlay colours to theme.json and all open overlays.{0}
zh-Hans.translation: 将叠加颜色应用于 theme.json 和所有打开的叠加。{0}

zh-Hans.source: Apply the original focus and Odyssey suit rules consistently to every passive overlay.
zh-Hans.translation: 将原始焦点和奥德赛套装规则一致地应用于每个被动覆盖。

zh-Hans.source: Approach a Guardian point before marking it empty.
zh-Hans.translation: 在将其标记为空之前接近守护点。

zh-Hans.source: Approach a Guardian ruins or structure settlement to activate its survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 接近守护者废墟或建筑定居点以启动其调查。

zh-Hans.source: Approach a Guardian site to begin proximity tracking.
zh-Hans.translation: 访问 Guardian 站点以开始近距离跟踪。

zh-Hans.source: Approach a local raw Guardian point before removing it.
zh-Hans.translation: 在移除本地原始守护点之前先接近它。

zh-Hans.source: Approach a relic tower before setting its heading.
zh-Hans.translation: 在设定航向之前接近遗迹塔。

zh-Hans.source: Approach an active Guardian obelisk before changing its scan state.
zh-Hans.translation: 在更改其扫描状态之前接近活动的守护者方尖碑。

zh-Hans.source: Approach an aligned settlement to author its template.
zh-Hans.translation: 接近一致的解决方案来编写其模板。

zh-Hans.source: Are you sure you want to proceed? Doing so will close all instances.
zh-Hans.translation: 您确定要继续吗？这样做将关闭所有实例。

zh-Hans.source: Are you sure? Unsaved changes in the workspace will be lost. Saved route files will not be deleted.
zh-Hans.translation: 你确定吗？工作区中未保存的更改将会丢失。保存的路线文件不会被删除。
工件要求将出现在这里。

zh-Hans.source: At an active ruins or structure, lists incomplete logs, matching obelisks, and available artifact counts.
zh-Hans.translation: 在活跃的废墟或建筑中，列出不完整的日志、匹配的方尖碑和可用的文物数量。

zh-Hans.source: At least one guide category is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 至少需要一种指南类别。

zh-Hans.source: At least one overlay placement is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 至少需要一个重叠放置。

zh-Hans.source: At least one overlay placement or a global opacity change is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 至少需要一个覆盖放置或全局不透明度更改。

zh-Hans.source: At startup, SrvSurvey checks the published version index and downloads only catalogs whose version changed.
zh-Hans.translation: 启动时，SrvSurvey 检查已发布的版本索引并仅下载版本已更改的目录。

zh-Hans.source: Audit cancelled after {0} of {1} boxels; partial progress was saved.
zh-Hans.translation: {0} 个 {1} 个框后取消审核；部分进度已保存。
审核在 {0} 个框后停止。

zh-Hans.source: Audited all {0} boxels and saved the refreshed progress.
zh-Hans.translation: 审核了所有 {0} 框并保存刷新的进度。

zh-Hans.source: Authoring changes remain in a session until explicitly committed or discarded.
zh-Hans.translation: 创作更改将保留在会话中，直到明确提交或放弃。

zh-Hans.source: Auto-copy next system in Galaxy Map
zh-Hans.translation: 自动复制银河地图中的下一个系统
重复时自动隐藏生物图
没有起落架时自动隐藏地面雷达
在最终样本上自动删除跟踪器
采样时自动删除跟踪器

zh-Hans.source: Automatic Fleet Carrier cargo sync is off.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动舰队承运商货物同步已关闭。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic detection is available on Windows. Use Choose folder for copied profiles, older installs, or migration on Linux.
zh-Hans.translation: Windows 上可以进行自动检测。在 Linux 上使用“选择文件夹”来复制配置文件、旧版安装或迁移。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic replacement is disabled because this copy was not launched from a checksum-indexed release package. Open the releases page to install manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动替换被禁用，因为该副本不是从校验和索引的发行包启动的。打开发布页面以手动安装。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic restart failed: {0} Close and reopen SrvSurvey manually; the verified import is safe.

zh-Hans.translation: 使用复制下一个系统，或在 Galaxy Map 中启用自动复制下一个系统，然后将名称粘贴到 Galaxy Map 中。 Boxel、Route Manager 和 FC Route 自动复制是互斥的。
使用 EDDN 测试架构

zh-Hans.source: Use FSS, body, system, route, and screenshot tools without losing the familiar original-overlay cues.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 FSS、主体、系统、路线和屏幕截图工具，而不会丢失熟悉的原始叠加提示。

zh-Hans.source: Use Mark Next Empty only when the Galaxy Map confirms that the next incomplete system does not exist. The marker is retained and the search skips to the following target.
zh-Hans.translation: 仅当 Galaxy Map 确认下一个不完整系统不存在时才使用“Mark Next Empty”。标记被保留，搜索跳至下一个目标。

zh-Hans.source: Use Next Elite window when several game clients are open and an overlay needs to follow a different window.
zh-Hans.translation: 当打开多个游戏客户端并且覆盖层需要遵循不同的窗口时，请使用“Next Elite”窗口。

zh-Hans.source: Use Refresh boxel to merge systems from the local Commander profile, the active route, and Spansh. Community databases contain only submitted observations, so an unknown system is not proof that it does not exist.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用刷新框合并本地指挥官配置文件、活动路线和 Spansh 中的系统。社区数据库仅包含提交的观察结果，因此未知系统并不能证明它不存在。

zh-Hans.source: Use Settings > Overlay behavior and layout to disable individual overlays or change their triggers.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用“设置”>“叠加层行为和布局”来禁用各个叠加层或更改其触发器。

zh-Hans.source: Use Show system notes to edit notes for the current system without leaving the game context.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用“显示系统注释”可以在不离开游戏上下文的情况下编辑当前系统的注释。

zh-Hans.source: Use Spansh for the system last-updated time
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 Spansh 作为系统上次更新时间
使用 SrvSurvey-XP 开发版本

zh-Hans.source: Use Stop search when you want the live Boxel workflow inactive while retaining its current profile state. Save Progress is the clearer choice when you intend to switch among several named projects.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您希望实时 Boxel 工作流程处于非活动状态同时保留其当前配置文件状态时，请使用停止搜索。当您打算在多个命名项目之间切换时，“保存进度”是更清晰的选择。

zh-Hans.source: Use Track location 1 through 8 shortcuts to toggle reusable surface bookmarks.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用轨道位置 1 至 8 快捷方式切换可重复使用的表面书签。

zh-Hans.source: Use a persisted folder for non-default Windows installations, Proton prefixes, and copied profiles.
zh-Hans.translation: 对非默认 Windows 安装、Proton 前缀和复制的配置文件使用持久文件夹。

zh-Hans.source: Use current restores the active Commander system as the distance origin.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用电流将活动 Commander 系统恢复为距离原点。

zh-Hans.source: Use one of the five original Guardian plotter sizes.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用五种原始 Guardian 绘图仪尺寸之一。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Boxel workspace after choosing a procedurally generated system whose surrounding sequence you want to survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择要调查其周围序列的程序生成的系统后，使用 Boxel 工作区。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Composition Scanner to identify organisms.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用成分扫描仪来识别生物体。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Multiple commanders card on Overview to launch an isolated SrvSurvey process for another saved profile.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用概述上的多个指挥官卡为另一个保存的配置文件启动独立的 SrvSurvey 进程。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Raven links when you need to review a project or system in the website.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您需要查看网站中的项目或系统时，请使用 Raven 链接。

zh-Hans.source: Use the check button to save every staged position, or X to close and restore the original layout.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用复选按钮保存每个舞台位置，或使用 X 关闭并恢复原始布局。

zh-Hans.source: Use the configurable jump-information shortcut to show or hide the route overlay manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用可配置的跳转信息快捷方式手动显示或隐藏路线叠加。

zh-Hans.source: Use the global overlay visibility shortcut when you need to hide or restore every detached overlay at once.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您需要一次隐藏或恢复每个分离的叠加层时，请使用全局叠加层可见性快捷方式。

zh-Hans.source: Use the live-overlay interaction shortcut to check bodies.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用实时叠加交互快捷方式来检查实体。

zh-Hans.source: Use the most recent visit to {0}.
Use the origin guidance to align an aerial screenshot. Type .map to return.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用原点引导来对齐航拍屏幕截图。输入 .map 返回。

zh-Hans.source: Use the original SrvSurvey shortcuts while either this application or Elite Dangerous has focus.
zh-Hans.translation: 当此应用程序或 Elite Dangerous 具有焦点时，使用原始 SrvSurvey 快捷方式。

zh-Hans.source: Use the original local-flora naming contract, retain an imported image cache, or download biology references for offline browsing.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用原始的本地植物区系命名合同，保留导入的图像缓存，或下载生物学参考文献以供离线浏览。

zh-Hans.source: Use the overlay color and warning text to distinguish valid in-radius destinations, out-of-radius systems, low mass codes, and already-surveyed systems.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用覆盖颜色和警告文本来区分有效的半径内目的地、半径外系统、低质量代码和已调查的系统。

zh-Hans.source: Use the quest communications shortcut to show or hide the overlay without stopping the quest.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用任务通信快捷方式显示或隐藏覆盖层，而无需停止任务。

zh-Hans.source: Use the same five visual identities available on Raven Colonial.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 Raven Colonial 上可用的相同五个视觉标识。

zh-Hans.source: Use the screenshot-data shortcut to enable or disable banners for future images.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用屏幕截图数据快捷方式启用或禁用未来图像的横幅。

zh-Hans.source: Use the smallest targeted recovery before considering a profile import or reset.
zh-Hans.translation: 在考虑配置文件导入或重置之前，请使用最小的目标恢复。

zh-Hans.source: Useful actions include overlay visibility, live interaction, map zoom, jump/FSS/body/station panels, colony shopping, system notes, boxel copy/paste, quest communications, VR adjustment, surface bookmarks, and screenshot data.
zh-Hans.translation: 有用的操作包括覆盖可见性、实时交互、地图缩放、跳跃/FSS/主体/站面板、殖民地购物、系统注释、boxel复制/粘贴、任务通信、VR调整、表面书签和屏幕截图数据。

zh-Hans.source: Uses current Spansh station data for pads, economies, faction, relevant services, and prohibited commodities. Alt+I toggles the overlay manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用当前的 Spansh 站点数据来获取 pad、经济体、派系、相关服务和违禁商品。 Alt+I 手动切换覆盖。

zh-Hans.source: Uses the Spansh system timestamp instead of the newest EDSM body timestamp in Jump Info and Galaxy Map summaries. This is a read-only lookup and does not publish journal data.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 Spansh 系统时间戳而不是跳转信息和银河地图摘要中最新的 EDSM 正文时间戳。这是只读查找，不会发布期刊数据。

zh-Hans.source: Uses the original SrvSurvey translations where available. New port-only text falls back to English.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用原始的 SrvSurvey 翻译（如果有）。新的仅端口文本回落为英语。

zh-Hans.source: Uses the same body-class, terraformability, discovery, mapping, Odyssey, and probe-efficiency formula as the WinForms application.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用与 WinForms 应用程序相同的主体等级、地形适应性、发现、绘图、Odyssey 和探测效率公式。

zh-Hans.source: Using separate native overlay windows for the current desktop host.
zh-Hans.translation: 为当前桌面主机使用单独的本机覆盖窗口。

zh-Hans.source: Using {0} validated catalog(s) from the imported legacy profile; all others use embedded defaults.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用导入的旧配置文件中的 {0} 经验证的目录；所有其他都使用嵌入式默认值。
使用 {0} {1} 作为距离原点。

zh-Hans.source: VR calibration '{0}' must be a string.
zh-Hans.translation: VR 校准“{0}”必须是字符串。

zh-Hans.source: VR calibrations could not be loaded: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法加载 VR 校准：{0}

zh-Hans.source: VR overlay adjustment captures and resets orientation through dedicated actions; capability and status are reported when the runtime is unavailable.
zh-Hans.translation: VR叠加调整通过专用动作捕捉和重置方向；当运行时不可用时，会报告功能和状态。

zh-Hans.source: VR override '{0}/{1}' could not be verified before saving.
zh-Hans.translation: VR 覆盖“{0}/{1}”在保存前无法验证。

zh-Hans.source: VR scale must be from 0.1 to 50 and all coordinates must be finite.
zh-Hans.translation: VR 比例必须在 0.1 到 50 之间，并且所有坐标必须是有限的。

zh-Hans.source: Validated embedded reference catalogs are active.
zh-Hans.translation: 经过验证的嵌入参考目录处于活动状态。
正在验证和导入开发任务...

zh-Hans.source: Validating the Raven API key without saving it...
zh-Hans.translation: 正在验证 Raven API 密钥而不保存它...

zh-Hans.source: Verification complete; restarting SrvSurvey with the migrated profile...
zh-Hans.translation: 验证完成；正在使用迁移的配置文件重新启动 SrvSurvey...

zh-Hans.source: Verified update replacement startup with the handoff helper.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用切换助手验证更新替换启动。
已验证的 {0} 暂存文件；准备回滚...

zh-Hans.source: Visible live overlays are clickable and can be dragged. Use the shortcut again to save and restore click-through mode.
zh-Hans.translation: 可见的实时叠加层可点击且可拖动。再次使用快捷方式保存并恢复点击模式。

zh-Hans.source: Visit the selected site before editing its commander survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 在编辑其指挥官调查之前访问所选站点。
访问过的星星参考缓存

zh-Hans.source: Visited-star cache swap/restore is blocked while Elite is running, uses a persistent original backup, validates responses, and rolls back failed activation.
zh-Hans.translation: 当 Elite 运行时，访问之星缓存交换/恢复会被阻止，使用持久的原始备份，验证响应，并回滚失败的激活。

zh-Hans.source: Visited-stars restore failed without discarding the current cache: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 访问过的星星恢复失败，未丢弃当前缓存：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Visited-stars setup could not be refreshed: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法刷新访问明星设置：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Visited-stars swap failed without replacing the original cache: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 访问过的星星交换失败，未替换原始缓存：{0}

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar is an independent boxel-surveying service. SrvSurvey can send selected new exploration journal events to it only after you opt in from the top of the Boxel workspace.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 是一项独立的 boxel 测量服务。仅当您从 Boxel 工作区顶部选择加入后，SrvSurvey 才可以向其发送选定的新探索日志事件。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar maintains its own database and says it does not forward these submissions to EDDN. Use a separate EDDN-capable tool when you also want to contribute discoveries to the wider community database.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 维护自己的数据库，并表示不会将这些提交转发给 EDDN。当您还想将发现贡献给更广泛的社区数据库时，请使用独立的 EDDN 功能工具。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar says it stores system names and coordinates, stars, planets and moons, exobiology discoveries, boxel classifications and metadata, discovery timestamps, and commander attribution for survey tracking, analysis, dashboards, and team collaboration.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 表示它存储系统名称和坐标、恒星、行星和卫星、外星生物学发现、boxel 分类和元数据、发现时间戳以及用于调查跟踪、分析、仪表板和团队协作的指挥官归因。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar upload cannot be enabled because this build does not include its integration signing key.
zh-Hans.translation: 无法启用 VoxStellar 上传，因为此版本不包含其集成签名密钥。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar upload is unavailable in this build because its integration signing key is not configured.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 上传在此版本中不可用，因为未配置其集成签名密钥。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar's terms say that you remain responsible for submitted content. By posting user content, you grant VoxStellar a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, modify, publicly perform, publicly display, reproduce, and distribute it through the service. The service is provided as-is and its policies may change.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 的条款规定，您仍然对提交的内容负责。通过发布用户内容，您授予 VoxStellar 全球范围内的、非独占的、免版税的许可，以通过服务使用、修改、公开执行、公开展示、复制和分发该内容。该服务按原样提供，其政策可能会发生变化。

zh-Hans.source: Wait for SrvSurvey to detect the active journal commander before connecting Frontier.
zh-Hans.translation: 在连接 Frontier 之前，等待 SrvSurvey 检测活动日志命令。

zh-Hans.source: Wait for the active commander name to load from the journal before connecting to Frontier or refreshing this page.
zh-Hans.translation: 在连接到 Frontier 或刷新此页面之前，等待活动指挥官名称从日志中加载。

zh-Hans.source: Wait for the manifest and verification summary. If activation fails, the staged destination is rolled back and the original folder remains unchanged.
zh-Hans.translation: 等待清单和验证摘要。如果激活失败，暂存目标将回滚，原始文件夹保持不变。

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for Commander Codex journal entries.
zh-Hans.translation: 等待指挥官法典日志条目。

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for Elite to write Cargo.json or ShipLocker.json.
zh-Hans.translation: 等待精英写入 Cargo.json 或 ShipLocker.json。

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for a biological system scan.
Waiting for a commander before calculating Codex completion.
zh-Hans.translation: 在计算法典完成之前等待指挥官。

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for a commander journal session.
Waiting for a detailed body scan
Waiting for a scanned body and surface coordinates.
zh-Hans.translation: 等待扫描的身体和表面坐标。
等待活跃的日志指挥官

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for surface position, body radius, and site heading.
zh-Hans.translation: 等待表面位置、身体半径和站点航向。

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for the Elite window before composing overlays.
zh-Hans.translation: 在合成叠加之前等待 Elite 窗口。

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for the commander journal session.
Waiting for the configured OpenVR runtime process.
zh-Hans.translation: 等待配置的 OpenVR 运行时进程。

zh-Hans.source: Waiting for the current commander and system.
zh-Hans.translation: 等待当前的指挥官和系统。
正在等待选定的控制器...

zh-Hans.source: Waiting to approach a human settlement.
Warning calls for attention. Danger marks an invalid, prohibited, failed, dead, or too-close state. Muted/dim means historical, unavailable, inactive, or already satisfied.
zh-Hans.translation: 警告呼吁注意。危险标志着无效、禁止、失败、死亡或过于接近的状态。静音/暗淡意味着历史、不可用、不活动或已经满意。

zh-Hans.source: Watching development source folder for changes.
zh-Hans.translation: 观察开发源文件夹的更改。

zh-Hans.source: Wayland overlay positioning, transparency, click-through, and global input require compositor support and are not enabled.
zh-Hans.translation: Wayland 叠加定位、透明度、点击率和全局输入需要合成器支持，并且未启用。

zh-Hans.source: What a boxel is and why survey one
zh-Hans.translation: 什么是 Boxel 以及为什么要调查 Boxel
本现场手册涵盖的内容

zh-Hans.source: When Require FSS is off, an FSD jump into a matching system completes it. When it is on, the system completes after Elite writes FSSAllBodiesFound. Use Complete or Reopen for a manual correction.
zh-Hans.translation: 当“要求 FSS”关闭时，FSD 跳转到匹配系统即可完成该操作。当它打开时，系统在 Elite 写入 FSSAllBodiesFound 后完成。使用“完成”或“重新打开”进行手动更正。

zh-Hans.source: When docking at a player colony, SrvSurvey can repair a Raven system-site entry that is missing its MarketID or final name.
zh-Hans.translation: 当停靠在玩家殖民地时，SrvSurvey 可以修复缺少 MarketID 或最终名称的 Raven 系统站点条目。

zh-Hans.source: When enabled, SrvSurvey can fetch your commander projects and keep newly recorded construction contributions, depot requirements, completion, and docking faction metadata in sync with Raven Colonial. Startup history is never published. This is off by default.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用后，SrvSurvey 可以获取您的指挥官项目，并与 Raven Colonial 同步新记录的建设贡献、仓库要求、完成情况和对接派系元数据。启动历史从未被公开。默认情况下此功能处于关闭状态。

zh-Hans.source: When enabled, SrvSurvey sends your commander name and the complete JSON data from these new live journal events: Scan, FSDTarget, FSDJump, FSSDiscoveryScan, SAASignalsFound, ScanOrganic, ScanBaryCentre, and CodexEntry.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用后，SrvSurvey 会发送您的指挥官姓名以及来自这些新实时日志事件的完整 JSON 数据：Scan、FSDTarget、FSSDJump、FSSDiscoveryScan、SAASignalsFound、ScanOrganic、ScanBaryCentre 和 CodexEntry。

zh-Hans.source: When enabled, matching live Scan journal events include commander name, system coordinates, and the original scan payload. Startup history is never uploaded.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用后，匹配的实时扫描日志事件包括指挥官名称、系统坐标和原始扫描负载。启动历史记录永远不会上传。

zh-Hans.source: When enabled, only a new live docking or manual alignment uploads the settlement identity, coordinates, pad layout, commander position, ship type, and calculated heading. Imported data, startup history, and Canonn lookups are never republished.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用后，只有新的实时对接或手动对齐才会上传定居点标识、坐标、平台布局、指挥官位置、船舶类型和计算的航向。导入的数据、启动历史记录和 Canonn 查找永远不会重新发布。

zh-Hans.source: When multiple Commanders share a folder, confirm the preferred Frontier ID and active Elite window.
zh-Hans.translation: 当多个指挥官共享一个文件夹时，请确认首选的 Frontier ID 和活动精英窗口。

zh-Hans.source: When multiple Elite windows are detected, EDDN queueing and delivery pause without deleting pending uploads. Only one SrvSurvey process can own the durable outbox at a time.
zh-Hans.translation: 当检测到多个 Elite 窗口时，EDDN 排队和传送会暂停，而不删除挂起的上传。一次只有一个 SrvSurvey 进程可以拥有持久发件箱。

zh-Hans.source: While a polygon is active, toggling ship shields captures the current point just like the original builder.
zh-Hans.translation: 当多边形处于活动状态时，切换船舶护罩会捕获当前点，就像原始构建器一样。

zh-Hans.source: Windows administrator approval is required to update this protected installation. The player profile remains untouched.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新此受保护的安装需要 Windows 管理员批准。玩家资料保持不变。

zh-Hans.source: Windows overlay input pass-through could not be enabled.
zh-Hans.translation: 无法启用 Windows 覆盖输入传递。

zh-Hans.source: Windows overlay interaction mode could not be changed (error {0}).
zh-Hans.translation: 无法更改 Windows 覆盖交互模式（错误 {0}）。

zh-Hans.source: Windows overlay interaction mode could not be refreshed (error {0}).
zh-Hans.translation: Windows覆盖交互模式无法刷新（错误{0}）。

zh-Hans.source: Windows topmost transparency, native click-through, and global keyboard input are available; game-window following is pending.
zh-Hans.translation: Windows顶层透明、原生点击、全局键盘输入可用；游戏窗口跟随待定。

zh-Hans.source: Windows topmost transparency, native click-through, game-window tracking, and global keyboard input are available.
zh-Hans.translation: 可以使用 Windows 最顶层透明度、本机点击、游戏窗口跟踪和全局键盘输入。
编写车队承运商航线注释...

zh-Hans.source: Wrong cargo: close extra Elite clients and wait for a fresh Cargo.json write from the intended Commander.
zh-Hans.translation: 错误的货物：关闭额外的精英客户端并等待来自目标指挥官的新的 Cargo.json 写入。

zh-Hans.source: X11 could not capture the Elite Dangerous window.
zh-Hans.translation: X11 无法捕获 Elite Dangerous 窗口。

zh-Hans.source: X11 is present, but click-through or game-window tracking could not be initialized; detached overlays are disabled.
zh-Hans.translation: X11 存在，但无法初始化点击或游戏窗口跟踪；分离的叠加层被禁用。

zh-Hans.source: X11 overlay interaction mode could not be changed: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法更改 X11 覆盖交互模式：{0}

zh-Hans.source: X11 overlay stacking policy: KDE on-screen display (advertised by the window manager).
zh-Hans.translation: X11 覆盖堆叠策略：KDE 屏幕显示（由窗口管理器通告）。

zh-Hans.source: X11 overlay stacking policy: standard topmost (KDE on-screen display support was not advertised).
zh-Hans.translation: X11 覆盖堆叠策略：标准最顶层（KDE 屏幕显示支持未公布）。

zh-Hans.source: X11 screen capture could not connect to the display.
zh-Hans.translation: X11 屏幕截图无法连接到显示器。

zh-Hans.source: X11 topmost transparency, XShape click-through, game-window tracking, and global keyboard input are available.

ps.translation: * A CHECK BESIDE VALUE MEANS THE DETAILED SURFACE SCAN IS COMPLETE. >>>!

ps.translation: * A NAMED POWER-CONTROL POINT IN A HUMAN SETTLEMENT. >>>!

ps.translation: * A ROTATED RECTANGULAR OUTLINE AND PAD NUMBER SHOW A SETTLEMENT LANDING PAD AND ITS ORIENTATION. >>>!

ps.translation: * CARGO CAPTURE IS PAUSED WHILE MULTIPLE ELITE WINDOWS ARE RUNNING BECAUSE CARGO.JSON CANNOT BE ATTRIBUTED SAFELY. >>>!

ps.translation: * CHANGES ONLY THE DISPLAYED FSS-COMPLETE STATISTIC. IT DOES NOT AFFECT BOXEL-SEARCH COMPLETION, NEXT TARGETS, BODY COUNTS, OR VALUES. >>>!

ps.translation: * CHANGES PREVIEW LIVE IN OPENVR. SAVE IS ATOMIC AND PRESERVES DESKTOP PLACEMENT PLUS UNKNOWN OVERLAYS. >>>!

ps.translation: * CHANGES WERE UNDONE TO THE ROUTE'S LAST SAVED STATE. >>>!

ps.source: Diagnostics exposes persisted application logs and the non-destructive crash-report workflow.
ps.translation: * DIAGNOSTICS EXPOSES PERSISTED APPLICATION LOGS AND THE NON-DESTRUCTIVE CRASH-REPORT WORKFLOW. >>>!

ps.source: Diagonal hatching marks a predicted organism or reward. Solid prediction segments show the dependable lower band; the darker possible segment shows how high the reward range may extend. Each segment retains its legacy solid outline. The dotted group frame spans the body's reported biological signal count; additional PIPs outside it are alternative genus candidates, not additive rewards.
ps.translation: * DIAGONAL HATCHING MARKS A PREDICTED ORGANISM OR REWARD. SOLID PREDICTION SEGMENTS SHOW THE DEPENDABLE LOWER BAND; THE DARKER POSSIBLE SEGMENT SHOWS HOW HIGH THE REWARD RANGE MAY EXTEND. EACH SEGMENT RETAINS ITS LEGACY SOLID OUTLINE. THE DOTTED GROUP FRAME SPANS THE BODY'S REPORTED BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL COUNT; ADDITIONAL PIPS OUTSIDE IT ARE ALTERNATIVE GENUS CANDIDATES, NOT ADDITIVE REWARDS. >>>!

ps.source: Displays target, route progress, discovery, traffic, services, Guardian sites, and followed-route notes while the FSD is charging or jumping.
ps.translation: * DISPLAYS TARGET, ROUTE PROGRESS, DISCOVERY, TRAFFIC, SERVICES, GUARDIAN SITES, AND FOLLOWED-ROUTE NOTES WHILE THE FSD IS CHARGING OR JUMPING. >>>!

ps.source: Distances unavailable until a journal supplies galactic coordinates.
ps.translation: * DISTANCES UNAVAILABLE UNTIL A JOURNAL SUPPLIES GALACTIC COORDINATES. >>>!

ps.source: Distances use the current journal system until a custom origin is selected.
ps.translation: * DISTANCES USE THE CURRENT JOURNAL SYSTEM UNTIL A CUSTOM ORIGIN IS SELECTED. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a Fleet Carrier to publish and link it. Registration preserves Raven's existing cargo; a freshly opened market is reconciled afterward.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A FLEET CARRIER TO PUBLISH AND LINK IT. REGISTRATION PRESERVES RAVEN'S EXISTING CARGO; A FRESHLY OPENED MARKET IS RECONCILED AFTERWARD. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a colonisation construction site first.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A COLONISATION CONSTRUCTION SITE FIRST. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a construction site and open Construction Services.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A CONSTRUCTION SITE AND OPEN CONSTRUCTION SERVICES. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a market and refresh Frontier data.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A MARKET AND REFRESH FRONTIER DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a supported station and refresh Frontier data.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A SUPPORTED STATION AND REFRESH FRONTIER DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at the Fleet Carrier and reopen its commodity market before syncing.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT THE FLEET CARRIER AND REOPEN ITS COMMODITY MARKET BEFORE SYNCING. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at the Fleet Carrier you want to publish and link.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT THE FLEET CARRIER YOU WANT TO PUBLISH AND LINK. >>>!

ps.source: Dots represent biological samples or bookmarks. Their surrounding circles show the organism colony radius.
ps.translation: * DOTS REPRESENT BIOLOGICAL SAMPLES OR BOOKMARKS. THEIR SURROUNDING CIRCLES SHOW THE ORGANISM COLONY RADIUS. >>>!

ps.source: Double-click a PNG to open it with the operating system.
ps.translation: * DOUBLE-CLICK A PNG TO OPEN IT WITH THE OPERATING SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Download all available biology images in the background
ps.translation: * DOWNLOAD ALL AVAILABLE BIOLOGY IMAGES IN THE BACKGROUND >>>!

ps.source: Download hash verified; validating archive files...
ps.translation: * DOWNLOAD HASH VERIFIED; VALIDATING ARCHIVE FILES... >>>!

ps.source: Download the AppImage from this release, make it executable, replace your existing AppImage file, and launch it again.
ps.translation: * DOWNLOAD THE APPIMAGE FROM THIS RELEASE, MAKE IT EXECUTABLE, REPLACE YOUR EXISTING APPIMAGE FILE, AND LAUNCH IT AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Downloaded catalogs are bounded, validated, checksummed, staged, and activated with health confirmation and rollback.
ps.translation: * DOWNLOADED CATALOGS ARE BOUNDED, VALIDATED, CHECKSUMMED, STAGED, AND ACTIVATED WITH HEALTH CONFIRMATION AND ROLLBACK. >>>!

ps.source: Downloading into the update cache. The installation and profile are still untouched.
ps.translation: * DOWNLOADING INTO THE UPDATE CACHE. THE INSTALLATION AND PROFILE ARE STILL UNTOUCHED. >>>!

ps.source: Draft points are previewed on the active settlement map. Nothing changes on disk until you choose an export destination.
ps.translation: * DRAFT POINTS ARE PREVIEWED ON THE ACTIVE SETTLEMENT MAP. NOTHING CHANGES ON DISK UNTIL YOU CHOOSE AN EXPORT DESTINATION. >>>!

ps.source: Drag the bordered previews to the desired monitors and positions. Preview content comes from a false game state shaped like real overlay data.
ps.translation: * DRAG THE BORDERED PREVIEWS TO THE DESIRED MONITORS AND POSITIONS. PREVIEW CONTENT COMES FROM A FALSE GAME STATE SHAPED LIKE REAL OVERLAY DATA. >>>!

ps.source: EDDN processing was isolated from journal tracking: {0}
ps.translation: * EDDN PROCESSING WAS ISOLATED FROM JOURNAL TRACKING: {0} >>>!

ps.source: EDDN publication, human-settlement geometry, Green Gas Giant candidates, Raven cargo, Fleet Carrier data, system updates, and quest publication each require the corresponding setting, credential, or explicit confirmation.
ps.translation: * EDDN PUBLICATION, HUMAN-SETTLEMENT GEOMETRY, GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATES, RAVEN CARGO, FLEET CARRIER DATA, SYSTEM UPDATES, AND QUEST PUBLICATION EACH REQUIRE THE CORRESPONDING SETTING, CREDENTIAL, OR EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION. >>>!

ps.source: Each PIP has the legacy translucent dotted outer frame plus a solid outline around every filled or possible-reward segment. Both border layers follow the PIP state and are independently configurable in Overlay appearance.
ps.translation: * EACH PIP HAS THE LEGACY TRANSLUCENT DOTTED OUTER FRAME PLUS A SOLID OUTLINE AROUND EVERY FILLED OR POSSIBLE-REWARD SEGMENT. BOTH BORDER LAYERS FOLLOW THE PIP STATE AND ARE INDEPENDENTLY CONFIGURABLE IN OVERLAY APPEARANCE. >>>!

ps.source: Each overlay has a specific game-state trigger and can also have a manual shortcut.
ps.translation: * EACH OVERLAY HAS A SPECIFIC GAME-STATE TRIGGER AND CAN ALSO HAVE A MANUAL SHORTCUT. >>>!

ps.source: Edit the shared geometry used by every site of this type. Drafts preview locally; only an explicitly selected JSON export file is changed.
ps.translation: * EDIT THE SHARED GEOMETRY USED BY EVERY SITE OF THIS TYPE. DRAFTS PREVIEW LOCALLY; ONLY AN EXPLICITLY SELECTED JSON EXPORT FILE IS CHANGED. >>>!

ps.source: Editing the selected commander survey. Save writes the legacy-compatible file atomically.
ps.translation: * EDITING THE SELECTED COMMANDER SURVEY. SAVE WRITES THE LEGACY-COMPATIBLE FILE ATOMICALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Elite Dangerous could not be focused after {0}; no matching game window was available.
ps.translation: * ELITE DANGEROUS COULD NOT BE FOCUSED AFTER {0}; NO MATCHING GAME WINDOW WAS AVAILABLE. >>>!

ps.source: Elite Dangerous is not running; file operations are available.
ps.translation: * ELITE DANGEROUS IS NOT RUNNING; FILE OPERATIONS ARE AVAILABLE. >>>!

ps.source: Elite must remain visible and foreground while first-footfall notification detection is active.
ps.translation: * ELITE MUST REMAIN VISIBLE AND FOREGROUND WHILE FIRST-FOOTFALL NOTIFICATION DETECTION IS ACTIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Green Gas Giant uploads in Settings before publishing historical candidates.
ps.translation: * ENABLE GREEN GAS GIANT UPLOADS IN SETTINGS BEFORE PUBLISHING HISTORICAL CANDIDATES. >>>!

ps.source: Enable OpenVR overlays before resetting headset orientation.
ps.translation: * ENABLE OPENVR OVERLAYS BEFORE RESETTING HEADSET ORIENTATION. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before loading a system.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE LOADING A SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before preparing a project.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE PREPARING A PROJECT. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before publishing a Fleet Carrier.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE PUBLISHING A FLEET CARRIER. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before publishing ship cargo.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE PUBLISHING SHIP CARGO. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before syncing Fleet Carrier cargo.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE SYNCING FLEET CARRIER CARGO. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial in Settings and save the API key for the active Commander.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL IN SETTINGS AND SAVE THE API KEY FOR THE ACTIVE COMMANDER. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Require FSS to report all bodies when entering a system is not enough and you want completion to wait for a full FSS identification.
ps.translation: * ENABLE REQUIRE FSS TO REPORT ALL BODIES WHEN ENTERING A SYSTEM IS NOT ENOUGH AND YOU WANT COMPLETION TO WAIT FOR A FULL FSS IDENTIFICATION. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Send Journal to VoxStellar for boxel surveying to upload new live Scan, FSDTarget, FSDJump, FSSDiscoveryScan, SAASignalsFound, ScanOrganic, ScanBaryCentre, and CodexEntry events with your Commander name.
ps.translation: * ENABLE SEND JOURNAL TO VOXSTELLAR FOR BOXEL SURVEYING TO UPLOAD NEW LIVE SCAN, FSDTARGET, FSDJUMP, FSSDISCOVERYSCAN, SAASIGNALSFOUND, SCANORGANIC, SCANBARYCENTRE, AND CODEXENTRY EVENTS WITH YOUR COMMANDER NAME. >>>!

ps.source: Enable global keyboard input below, then use this shortcut to make existing live overlays clickable and draggable. Use it again to save positions and restore click-through mode; it never opens the full editor.
ps.translation: * ENABLE GLOBAL KEYBOARD INPUT BELOW, THEN USE THIS SHORTCUT TO MAKE EXISTING LIVE OVERLAYS CLICKABLE AND DRAGGABLE. USE IT AGAIN TO SAVE POSITIONS AND RESTORE CLICK-THROUGH MODE; IT NEVER OPENS THE FULL EDITOR. >>>!

ps.source: Enable or disable data banners on future screenshots.
ps.translation: * ENABLE OR DISABLE DATA BANNERS ON FUTURE SCREENSHOTS. >>>!

ps.source: Enable the filename, folder, banner, or aerial-alignment options you want.
ps.translation: * ENABLE THE FILENAME, FOLDER, BANNER, OR AERIAL-ALIGNMENT OPTIONS YOU WANT. >>>!

ps.source: Enable the limit to evaluate the current system
ps.translation: * ENABLE THE LIMIT TO EVALUATE THE CURRENT SYSTEM >>>!

ps.source: Enter a biological signal or missing variants to find nearby systems.
ps.translation: * ENTER A BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL OR MISSING VARIANTS TO FIND NEARBY SYSTEMS. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a generated system name, ordinary system name, or id64 in Top boxel or generated system. Select an EDSM suggestion when one appears so SrvSurvey retains the authoritative id64.
ps.translation: * ENTER A GENERATED SYSTEM NAME, ORDINARY SYSTEM NAME, OR ID64 IN TOP BOXEL OR GENERATED SYSTEM. SELECT AN EDSM SUGGESTION WHEN ONE APPEARS SO SRVSURVEY RETAINS THE AUTHORITATIVE ID64. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a genus, species, and at least one variant color.
ps.translation: * ENTER A GENUS, SPECIES, AND AT LEAST ONE VARIANT COLOR. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a live Elite system before loading Raven sites.
ps.translation: * ENTER A LIVE ELITE SYSTEM BEFORE LOADING RAVEN SITES. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a name for this route. It will be stored in your commander route library.
ps.translation: * ENTER A NAME FOR THIS ROUTE. IT WILL BE STORED IN YOUR COMMANDER ROUTE LIBRARY. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a star-system name to set a custom origin.
ps.translation: * ENTER A STAR-SYSTEM NAME TO SET A CUSTOM ORIGIN. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a system name to search.
ps.translation: * ENTER A SYSTEM NAME TO SEARCH. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a system to browse biological Codex entries.
ps.translation: * ENTER A SYSTEM TO BROWSE BIOLOGICAL CODEX ENTRIES. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a valid generated system and lower mass code.
ps.translation: * ENTER A VALID GENERATED SYSTEM AND LOWER MASS CODE. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a valid generated system or boxel name.
ps.translation: * ENTER A VALID GENERATED SYSTEM OR BOXEL NAME. >>>!

ps.source: Enter coordinates in Travel or send .target here through the in-game chat journal to capture the current location.
ps.translation: * ENTER COORDINATES IN TRAVEL OR SEND .TARGET HERE THROUGH THE IN-GAME CHAT JOURNAL TO CAPTURE THE CURRENT LOCATION. >>>!

ps.source: Enter one key with ALT, CTRL, or SHIFT, or leave blank.
ps.translation: * ENTER ONE KEY WITH ALT, CTRL, OR SHIFT, OR LEAVE BLANK. >>>!

ps.source: Enter or scan a system with biological signals.
ps.translation: * ENTER OR SCAN A SYSTEM WITH BIOLOGICAL SIGNALS. >>>!

ps.source: Enter the biological signal to find.
ps.translation: * ENTER THE BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL TO FIND. >>>!

ps.source: Enter the current route, boxel, or clipboard target in the Galaxy Map.
ps.translation: * ENTER THE CURRENT ROUTE, BOXEL, OR CLIPBOARD TARGET IN THE GALAXY MAP. >>>!

ps.source: Entire saved search combines recorded systems and bodies from every boxel in that saved search before calculating the average.
ps.translation: * ENTIRE SAVED SEARCH COMBINES RECORDED SYSTEMS AND BODIES FROM EVERY BOXEL IN THAT SAVED SEARCH BEFORE CALCULATING THE AVERAGE. >>>!

ps.source: Entries remain visible in this session, but the log file could not be updated: {0}
ps.translation: * ENTRIES REMAIN VISIBLE IN THIS SESSION, BUT THE LOG FILE COULD NOT BE UPDATED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Error details copied to the clipboard.
ps.translation: * ERROR DETAILS COPIED TO THE CLIPBOARD. >>>!

ps.source: Every Raven site requires a name.
ps.translation: * EVERY RAVEN SITE REQUIRES A NAME. >>>!

ps.source: Every lower level multiplies the work: one boxel has eight direct children, and selecting several levels can create a very large search tree.
ps.translation: * EVERY LOWER LEVEL MULTIPLIES THE WORK: ONE BOXEL HAS EIGHT DIRECT CHILDREN, AND SELECTING SEVERAL LEVELS CAN CREATE A VERY LARGE SEARCH TREE. >>>!

ps.source: Exact predictions are disabled in system-survey settings.
ps.translation: * EXACT PREDICTIONS ARE DISABLED IN SYSTEM-SURVEY SETTINGS. >>>!

ps.source: Executable releases and reference catalogs are checked and activated independently.
ps.translation: * EXECUTABLE RELEASES AND REFERENCE CATALOGS ARE CHECKED AND ACTIVATED INDEPENDENTLY. >>>!

ps.source: Exobiology totals show samples and rewards that have not yet been sold.
ps.translation: * EXOBIOLOGY TOTALS SHOW SAMPLES AND REWARDS THAT HAVE NOT YET BEEN SOLD. >>>!

ps.source: Expand to edit all original keyboard actions.
ps.translation: * EXPAND TO EDIT ALL ORIGINAL KEYBOARD ACTIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Exploration totals combine jump, scan, mapping, landing, distance, and estimated reward state for the active profile.
ps.translation: * EXPLORATION TOTALS COMBINE JUMP, SCAN, MAPPING, LANDING, DISTANCE, AND ESTIMATED REWARD STATE FOR THE ACTIVE PROFILE. >>>!

ps.source: Exploration, Exobiology, Travel, Search, Guardian, Quests, and Colonization contain activity-specific tools.
ps.translation: * EXPLORATION, EXOBIOLOGY, TRAVEL, SEARCH, GUARDIAN, QUESTS, AND COLONIZATION CONTAIN ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC TOOLS. >>>!

ps.source: Explore sites, review surveys, and track both Ram Tah research missions.
ps.translation: * EXPLORE SITES, REVIEW SURVEYS, AND TRACK BOTH RAM TAH RESEARCH MISSIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Exported and verified {0} Guardian templates; the previous file was backed up.
ps.translation: * EXPORTED AND VERIFIED {0} GUARDIAN TEMPLATES; THE PREVIOUS FILE WAS BACKED UP. >>>!

ps.source: Exported and verified {0} settlement templates; the previous file was backed up.
ps.translation: * EXPORTED AND VERIFIED {0} SETTLEMENT TEMPLATES; THE PREVIOUS FILE WAS BACKED UP. >>>!

ps.source: Exports only boxels with at least this many recorded systems. Counts and stored data do not change.
ps.translation: * EXPORTS ONLY BOXELS WITH AT LEAST THIS MANY RECORDED SYSTEMS. COUNTS AND STORED DATA DO NOT CHANGE. >>>!

ps.source: External reads and every upload path are visible and separately gated.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL READS AND EVERY UPLOAD PATH ARE VISIBLE AND SEPARATELY GATED. >>>!

ps.source: External system resolution is clearly reported when a lookup service is unavailable or disabled.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL SYSTEM RESOLUTION IS CLEARLY REPORTED WHEN A LOOKUP SERVICE IS UNAVAILABLE OR DISABLED. >>>!

ps.source: External timestamps describe when a community service last received data, not guaranteed first-discovery or current in-game completeness. Treat skip rules as workflow filters rather than proof that a system has nothing left to discover.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL TIMESTAMPS DESCRIBE WHEN A COMMUNITY SERVICE LAST RECEIVED DATA, NOT GUARANTEED FIRST-DISCOVERY OR CURRENT IN-GAME COMPLETENESS. TREAT SKIP RULES AS WORKFLOW FILTERS RATHER THAN PROOF THAT A SYSTEM HAS NOTHING LEFT TO DISCOVER. >>>!

ps.source: External-data enrichment can add prior discovery, traffic, station, and biological context when its privacy setting is enabled.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL-DATA ENRICHMENT CAN ADD PRIOR DISCOVERY, TRAFFIC, STATION, AND BIOLOGICAL CONTEXT WHEN ITS PRIVACY SETTING IS ENABLED. >>>!

ps.source: FC Routes accepts Spansh Fleet Carrier Router result URLs only.
ps.translation: * FC ROUTES ACCEPTS SPANSH FLEET CARRIER ROUTER RESULT URLS ONLY. >>>!

ps.source: FSS overlays follow FSS focus; body and biology overlays follow the current body; maps follow nearby site or surface state; travel overlays follow targets and routes; shopping follows active construction context.
ps.translation: * FSS OVERLAYS FOLLOW FSS FOCUS; BODY AND BIOLOGY OVERLAYS FOLLOW THE CURRENT BODY; MAPS FOLLOW NEARBY SITE OR SURFACE STATE; TRAVEL OVERLAYS FOLLOW TARGETS AND ROUTES; SHOPPING FOLLOWS ACTIVE CONSTRUCTION CONTEXT. >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning capture is temporarily unavailable: {0}
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING CAPTURE IS TEMPORARILY UNAVAILABLE: {0} >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning detection is active, but its diagnostic image could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING DETECTION IS ACTIVE, BUT ITS DIAGNOSTIC IMAGE COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning detection is not supported on this platform.
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING DETECTION IS NOT SUPPORTED ON THIS PLATFORM. >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning detection requires an X11 session; direct screen capture is unavailable on Wayland.
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING DETECTION REQUIRES AN X11 SESSION; DIRECT SCREEN CAPTURE IS UNAVAILABLE ON WAYLAND. >>>!

ps.source: Face the Guardian alignment feature and type .heading again.
ps.translation: * FACE THE GUARDIAN ALIGNMENT FEATURE AND TYPE .HEADING AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Face the mapped alignment feature and send .heading; send .heading followed by degrees when entering a heading directly.
ps.translation: * FACE THE MAPPED ALIGNMENT FEATURE AND SEND .HEADING; SEND .HEADING FOLLOWED BY DEGREES WHEN ENTERING A HEADING DIRECTLY. >>>!

ps.source: Face the mapped alignment feature and type .heading, or use .heading <degrees>.
ps.translation: * FACE THE MAPPED ALIGNMENT FEATURE AND TYPE .HEADING, OR USE .HEADING <DEGREES>. >>>!

ps.source: Fetching active projects from Raven Colonial...
ps.translation: * FETCHING ACTIVE PROJECTS FROM RAVEN COLONIAL... >>>!

ps.source: Filters can show only mission logs still needed for the active Ram Tah task.
ps.translation: * FILTERS CAN SHOW ONLY MISSION LOGS STILL NEEDED FOR THE ACTIVE RAM TAH TASK. >>>!

ps.source: Find nearby bodies with selected biological color variants.
ps.translation: * FIND NEARBY BODIES WITH SELECTED BIOLOGICAL COLOR VARIANTS. >>>!

ps.source: Find the last recorded FSD jump into {0}.
ps.translation: * FIND THE LAST RECORDED FSD JUMP INTO {0}. >>>!

ps.source: Find the most recent FSD jump into {0}.
ps.translation: * FIND THE MOST RECENT FSD JUMP INTO {0}. >>>!

ps.source: Find the nearest systems containing a Canonn codex signal.
ps.translation: * FIND THE NEAREST SYSTEMS CONTAINING A CANONN CODEX SIGNAL. >>>!

ps.source: First footfall inferred from Elite's on-screen notification after {0} sample(s); match ratio {1}.
ps.translation: * FIRST FOOTFALL INFERRED FROM ELITE'S ON-SCREEN NOTIFICATION AFTER {0} SAMPLE(S); MATCH RATIO {1}. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall rewards apply to analyzed organisms.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL REWARDS APPLY TO ANALYZED ORGANISMS. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall screen inference was not configured.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL SCREEN INFERENCE WAS NOT CONFIGURED. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall state cannot be changed until the current body is known.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL STATE CANNOT BE CHANGED UNTIL THE CURRENT BODY IS KNOWN. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall state cannot be changed until the current system is known.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL STATE CANNOT BE CHANGED UNTIL THE CURRENT SYSTEM IS KNOWN. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall status can change reward presentation because a confirmed first footfall multiplies biological sale value.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL STATUS CAN CHANGE REWARD PRESENTATION BECAUSE A CONFIRMED FIRST FOOTFALL MULTIPLIES BIOLOGICAL SALE VALUE. >>>!

ps.source: Fitted loadout grouped by hardpoints, utility, core, military, and optional slots
ps.translation: * FITTED LOADOUT GROUPED BY HARDPOINTS, UTILITY, CORE, MILITARY, AND OPTIONAL SLOTS >>>!

ps.source: Fleet Carrier cargo was not updated: {0}
ps.translation: * FLEET CARRIER CARGO WAS NOT UPDATED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Fleet Carrier cargo will sync from matching Market.json updates.
ps.translation: * FLEET CARRIER CARGO WILL SYNC FROM MATCHING MARKET.JSON UPDATES. >>>!

ps.source: Focus Elite after each live FSD jump
ps.translation: * FOCUS ELITE AFTER EACH LIVE FSD JUMP >>>!

ps.source: Focus Elite when SrvSurvey is minimized
ps.translation: * FOCUS ELITE WHEN SRVSURVEY IS MINIMIZED >>>!

ps.source: Focused the next Elite Dangerous window; overlays will follow it.
ps.translation: * FOCUSED THE NEXT ELITE DANGEROUS WINDOW; OVERLAYS WILL FOLLOW IT. >>>!

ps.source: Follow communications, objectives, settlement routes, massacre progress, and optional developer-authored quest chapters.
ps.translation: * FOLLOW COMMUNICATIONS, OBJECTIVES, SETTLEMENT ROUTES, MASSACRE PROGRESS, AND OPTIONAL DEVELOPER-AUTHORED QUEST CHAPTERS. >>>!

ps.source: Follow the circular bearing display relative to ship heading. The attack-angle line helps judge descent toward the target.
ps.translation: * FOLLOW THE CIRCULAR BEARING DISPLAY RELATIVE TO SHIP HEADING. THE ATTACK-ANGLE LINE HELPS JUDGE DESCENT TOWARD THE TARGET. >>>!

ps.source: For an active sample, warning color inside the radius means you are too close; success color outside the radius means the next sample is valid.
ps.translation: * FOR AN ACTIVE SAMPLE, WARNING COLOR INSIDE THE RADIUS MEANS YOU ARE TOO CLOSE; SUCCESS COLOR OUTSIDE THE RADIUS MEANS THE NEXT SAMPLE IS VALID. >>>!

ps.source: For example the end system of the {0} boxel is: {1} so you would enter 7640 and choose APPLY
ps.translation: * FOR EXAMPLE THE END SYSTEM OF THE {0} BOXEL IS: {1} SO YOU WOULD ENTER 7640 AND CHOOSE APPLY >>>!

ps.source: Found 1 matching system. Review it before enabling.
ps.translation: * FOUND 1 MATCHING SYSTEM. REVIEW IT BEFORE ENABLING. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} Green Gas Giant candidate(s); no candidate was published.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATE(S); NO CANDIDATE WAS PUBLISHED. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} historical Green Gas Giant candidate(s). Publishing sends only the original matching Scan event, commander name, tag, and journal StarPos.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} HISTORICAL GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATE(S). PUBLISHING SENDS ONLY THE ORIGINAL MATCHING SCAN EVENT, COMMANDER NAME, TAG, AND JOURNAL STARPOS. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} legacy profile source(s). Import creates checksum-verified backups, preserves current-only files, records collisions, and activates the merged copy transactionally.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} LEGACY PROFILE SOURCE(S). IMPORT CREATES CHECKSUM-VERIFIED BACKUPS, PRESERVES CURRENT-ONLY FILES, RECORDS COLLISIONS, AND ACTIVATES THE MERGED COPY TRANSACTIONALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} matches. Choose the center system.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} MATCHES. CHOOSE THE CENTER SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Fresh Market and Cargo events reconcile carrier and ship totals. Ambiguous multi-client cargo is excluded until a fresh unambiguous file write arrives.
ps.translation: * FRESH MARKET AND CARGO EVENTS RECONCILE CARRIER AND SHIP TOTALS. AMBIGUOUS MULTI-CLIENT CARGO IS EXCLUDED UNTIL A FRESH UNAMBIGUOUS FILE WRITE ARRIVES. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier account linking is currently supported on Windows and Linux.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER ACCOUNT LINKING IS CURRENTLY SUPPORTED ON WINDOWS AND LINUX. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier authorization expired or was revoked. Connect your account again.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION EXPIRED OR WAS REVOKED. CONNECT YOUR ACCOUNT AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier authorization expired. Unlink and reconnect your account.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION EXPIRED. UNLINK AND RECONNECT YOUR ACCOUNT. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier authorization storage has no parent directory.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION STORAGE HAS NO PARENT DIRECTORY. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION TIMED OUT. PLEASE TRY AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier authorization was cancelled or replaced.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION WAS CANCELLED OR REPLACED. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZED {0}, BUT THE ACTIVE JOURNAL BELONGS TO {1}. NO AUTHORIZATION WAS ATTACHED TO THE ACTIVE COMMANDER. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER CALLBACK COMPLETED WITHOUT A RUNNING APPLICATION WINDOW TO RESTORE. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier callback restored the running application.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER CALLBACK RESTORED THE RUNNING APPLICATION. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER COMMUNITY-GOAL DATA COULD NOT BE READ: {0} >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER COULD NOT COMPLETE THE TOKEN EXCHANGE. PLEASE CONNECT AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier credential lock has no parent directory.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER CREDENTIAL LOCK HAS NO PARENT DIRECTORY. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER FLEET-CARRIER DATA COULD NOT BE READ: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Frontier is rate limiting requests. Please wait before trying again.
